description: Micro-orm implemented on Dapper, streamlines connection and transaction management while preserving flexibility and usability of Dapper.
releaseNotes:
* 3.1.1
* Fix: when opening the connection fails in Batch or BatchAsync (and every one-shot DbContext call) and disposing it then also throws, the open failure is now the exception thrown; before, the disposal failure replaced it. No API change.
* 3.1.0
* Adds DbContext<T>.FromFactory(connectionFactory, columnNames): the factory returns a new, closed connection per call or batch (provider data sources, per-connection sign-in tokens, test connections). Additive: the string constructor and every 3.0.0 call compile and behave as before.
* 3.0.0
* Targets net10.0 only; moves all types to Dapper.Data.
* IDbContext/ISession/IDbCommand -> DbContext<T>/DbSession<T>.
* Abstract DbContext(IDbConnectionFactory) -> new DbContext<T>(connectionString, columnNames).
* SqlDbContext(cs) -> DbContext<Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection>(cs).
* Single/Single<T>/Single(Type) -> QuerySingleOrDefault.
* Query<T>, Query(Type), multi-map Query<T1..T5,TReturn> and CommandDefinition overloads -> Dapper on session.Connection with session.Transaction.
* Query<IDictionary<string,object>> -> Query, then cast each row.
* commandTimeout defaults to null (provider default); pass 0 to keep infinite.
* A second BeginTransaction and Commit without a transaction now throw.
* DbServiceProvider, DbService, ConnectionStringBuilder and SqlConnectionFactory are removed; use the provider's DbConnectionStringBuilder.
* Adds async APIs, explicit First/Single methods and configurable ordinal column matching.
* Missing dynamic columns and duplicate result columns throw; alias duplicate columns.
* Uncommitted batches roll back and throw; sessions and readers cannot outlive their batch.
* 2.0.0
* Upgraded assembly to be compatable with .net core and standard
* Broke dependence on ConnectionManager. You will need to create
* Db spesific connection factory see [SqlConnectionFactory] as an exaple.
* 1.14
* changed commandTimeout to 0 by default (infinite)
* 1.11
* Using new version of Dapper
* added commandTimeout to api
* added CommandDefinition to api
* added QueryMultiple
* Query<T> will check if T is IDictionary<string, object> and will return data as IDictionary<string, object>
* 1.7
* Enable overriding service using RegisterService
* 1.6
* Refactored common common commands in to IDbCommand interface
* Added multi mapping query support
* 1.4
* DbServiceProvider now implements IServiceProvider
* For is obsolete use GetService to retreave services
* Included T4 template to use on dataset to create services. T4 name must match dataset name. Also when adding dataset clear its custom tool property. The dataset is used only as GUI designer for your POCO(s) and services. The T4 will create one interface per table and a one interface that implement's IDbService and one base class that inherit's DbService eposing all queries defined in dataset as methods.
* 1.0
* Streamlined connection and transaction management
* Batch query processing
* Can use ninject
* Thread safe
* Connection can be defined in .config file
title: Dapper.Data
